patch_description: Builds on the best prior program (two-pass Kalman/RTS with locally adaptive per-sample process noise + zero-phase Whittaker polish) and adds the recommended velocity-aware displacement clamp: after the second RTS refinement pass, a forward + mirrored backward clamp limits per-step displacement |y[k]−y[k−1]| ≤ 2·|v[k]| + slack·σ_r, where v[k] is the smoother's own velocity state and slack is expanded if a correlation guard (corr < 0.97 vs. unclamped) fires. This directly suppresses noise-induced slope reversals (the dominant composite levers: smoothness 0.50, false reversals 14.2) while genuine trend steps pass untouched because the velocity state is large there — the clamp is effectively zero-phase since it's applied symmetrically. The Whittaker banded polish with constant lambda replaces the cascaded one-pole damper for flatter passband / sharper ripple stopband.
